note: Layout Custom Section Classes adds ID/class/class-list/style/data-* attribute fields to Layout Builder sections and their regions via hook_form_layout_builder_configure_section_alter, applied at render by hook_preprocess_layout. It defines no plugin TYPES. A single global config object 'layout_custom_section_classes.settings' (configure route layout_custom_section_classes.settings at /admin/config/content/layout-builder-section-attributes) controls which attribute types are offered via allowed_section_attributes.{id,class,class_list,style,data} and allowed_section_region_attributes.{...} (booleans), a predefined class_list (sequence of 'class' or 'class|Friendly name' strings), and relax_css_validation (bool). It defines 3 permissions. Per-section values live on the layout plugin config (custom_id, custom_classes, custom_class_choose, custom_styles, custom_data_attributes, regions.<id>.region_*). Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real settings config: introspection reads back the predefined class list / whether data-* is allowed; execution adds a predefined class and disables inline styles, verified against the live config. All cleanups restore the shipped defaults explicitly (all attributes true, class_list empty, relax off).

evals.prompt: Using the layout_custom_section_classes module, what kinds of HTML attributes can an editor add to a Layout Builder section, and where is the settings page that controls which of them are available?
evals.expected_output: Editors can add an ID, CSS class(es), a predefined class list, inline styles, and data-* attributes to a section (and to each region). Which are offered is controlled by the settings form at /admin/config/content/layout-builder-section-attributes (config layout_custom_section_classes.settings) via allowed_section_attributes.{id,class,class_list,style,data}.

evals.prompt: I set custom classes on a Layout Builder section with layout_custom_section_classes but they don't appear in the markup. What does the layout's Twig template need for section (and region) classes to render?
evals.expected_output: The chosen layout template must print {{ attributes }} for the section (e.g. {{ attributes.addClass(classes) }}) and {{ region_attributes.REGION }} for each region. hook_preprocess_layout pushes the values onto those variables; a template that hard-codes its wrapper without them drops the classes.

evals.prompt: With layout_custom_section_classes, how can I give editors a fixed list of CSS classes to choose from (instead of free-typing), and how do I show a friendly label for each class?
evals.expected_output: On the settings form fill 'CSS classes to choose from' (config key class_list), one class per line. Use 'class-name|Friendly name' to show a friendly label; the part before | is the actual class. Editors then see a 'Choose classes' checkbox list (custom_class_choose) on the section form.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, layout_custom_section_classes has a predefined list of CSS classes configured for Layout Builder sections. Inspect the live module settings and tell me the CSS class names in that predefined list.
evals.expected_output: In layout_custom_section_classes.settings the class_list is [bg-eval-dark|Dark background, py-eval-3], i.e. the classes bg-eval-dark and py-eval-3.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the layout_custom_section_classes settings and tell me whether editors are currently allowed to add data-* attributes to Layout Builder sections.
evals.expected_output: No — in layout_custom_section_classes.settings, allowed_section_attributes.data is false, so the data-* attribute field is not offered for sections (other section attributes remain enabled).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the layout_custom_section_classes predefined class list is currently empty. Using the module's settings, add a predefined CSS class named 'lcsc-task-class' so editors can pick it for Layout Builder sections. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In layout_custom_section_classes.settings the class_list sequence gains an entry 'lcsc-task-class' (optionally 'lcsc-task-class|Friendly name').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the layout_custom_section_classes settings to stop editors from adding inline CSS styles to Layout Builder sections (leave the other section attributes as they are). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In layout_custom_section_classes.settings, allowed_section_attributes.style is set to false (the inline-style field is no longer offered for sections).
